neighbours.label: the preposition that marks what something is separated or kept apart from ('separate X from Y', 'von ... fernhalten', 'отделяют от'), as opposed to 'from' marking an origin, source or starting point
fire: After the harvest, workers separate the chaff from the grain by hand.
It is hard for young children to distinguish fantasy from reality.
Doctors decided to isolate the sick patient from the other residents.
The court ruled that church must be kept separate from state.
Carefully detach the label from the bottle before recycling it.
Twins are often hard to tell apart from each other at first.
Sie trennten die Kranken von den Gesunden.
The new wall will separate the old town from the busy harbor.
quiet: After the harvest, workers carry the grain from the field by hand.
It is hard for young children to wake up early from Monday to Friday.
Doctors received a phone call from the other residents.
The court ruled on a case sent up from the state.
Carefully pour the water from the bottle into a glass.
Twins often get presents from their grandparents at first.
Sie kamen gestern von der Arbeit nach Hause.
The new ferry will sail from the old town to the busy harbor.
